summary: Verizon ABS II LLC and Verizon Master Trust filed a 424B5 prospectus for a $1.2 billion Series 2026-2 asset-backed note offering backed by device payment plan agreements originated by Cellco Partnership d/b/a Verizon Wireless. The notes are secured by the issuing entity's assets and are payable from designated group 1 collections. The offering includes four tranches: Class A-1a at 4.51%, Class A-1b at Compounded SOFR+0.46%, and fixed-rate Class B and C notes. This is a routine securitization, not a special situation. There are no deal terms applicable.
